text: After the canoe landed, we rested on the sandy bank beside the river.

Erosion made the steep shoreline unstable after winter rain.
A willow leaned above the water where the river curved north.
The rescue crew approached the flooded bank by boat.
Tracks in the mud followed the waterline for several metres.
The picnic area overlooked both banks of the narrow stream.
